# Chapter 38 – Producer

Scene 1. Gabriel marks the moment in the archive: they are no longer only users of imported goods.

Scene 2. Jonah pushes for a larger fabrication program.

Scene 3. Arun remains cautious because bad parts in critical systems can kill faster than shortages.

Scene 4. Tomas proposes using robots for repetitive manufacturing support.

Scene 5. Elena approves a scaled trial. Bridge: Manufacturing leads naturally to construction.
